precious_blood_collect.text: Almighty and eternal God, Thou hast appointed Thine only-begotten Son the Redeemer of the world, and willedst to be appeased by His Blood. Grant, we beg of Thee, that we may worthily adore this price of our salvation, and that through its power we may be safeguarded from the evils of the present life, so that we may rejoice in its fruits forever in Heaven. Through the same Christ our Lord. Amen.
precious_blood_collect.source: Litany of the Precious Blood (redaction of the Sacred Congregation of Rites, promulgated by Pope John XXIII, February 24, 1960); closing collect

schedule_note.note: The Litany of the Most Precious Blood in the official redaction of the Sacred Congregation of Rites (promulgated by Pope John XXIII, February 24, 1960) — 24 invocations of the Blood answered "save us."; the official redaction is a liturgical text of 1960 whose invocations carry the traditional formulaic wording. The four Trinitarian lead-ins are answered "have mercy on us."; followed by the Agnus Dei versicles, the Apocaﬁpse versicle ("Thou hast redeemed us…"), and the received collect. Especially fitting in July (the month of the Precious Blood) and on Fridays.
